meta.name: referrals
meta.description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or analyze a referral program, affiliate program, or word-of-mouth strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'referral,' 'affiliate,' 'ambassador,' 'word of mouth,' 'viral loop,' 'refer a friend,' 'partner program,' 'referral incentive,' 'how to get referrals,' 'customers referring customers,' or 'affiliate payout.' Use this whenever someone wants existing users or partners to bring in new customers. For launch-specific virality, see launch.

copy.tagline: 设计并优化老带新推荐计划,让客户持续帮你拉新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果创业初期想靠老客户口碑带来新用户
copy.tagline_en: Create referral programs that turn customers into new signups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want existing customers to bring in new ones through referral rewards

howto.what: 当你谈论推荐、联盟或口碑拉新时，Claude 会先检索已有的产品营销资料，然后收集你的业务背景（如客户终身价值、获客成本），判断产品是否适合做病毒式传播，再给出推荐计划与联盟计划的选择建议、激励结构设计、优化方案、衡量指标、启动清单和邮件模板。
howto.when: 当你想让现有用户或合作伙伴带来新客户，或想创建、优化、分析推荐/联盟/口碑计划，或提到 “referral”“affiliate” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个老客户推荐新客户的奖励方案
say.note: 会收集你的业务背景并给出激励结构建议。

say.text: 我的联盟计划转化率很低，帮我分析原因
say.note: 会引导你提供关键数据并列出优化点。

say.text: 我该选推荐计划还是联盟计划？
say.note: 会根据你的产品和客户情况给出对比建议。

howto.what_en: Claude reads existing marketing files, asks about your business (LTV, CAC, product fit), assesses viral fit, then suggests referral vs. affiliate designs, incentives, optimization, metrics, launch checklists, and email templates.
howto.when_en: When the user wants existing users or partners to bring new customers, or wants to create/optimize/analyze referral, affiliate, or word-of-mouth programs, or mentions 'referral,' 'affiliate,' etc.

say_en.text: Design a referral reward program for existing customers referring new ones.
say_en.note: Claude asks about your business, then suggests incentives.

say_en.text: My affiliate program converts poorly — analyze why and fix it.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for key data and list optimization points.

say_en.text: Should I use a referral program or an affiliate program?
say_en.note: Claude compares options for your product and customers.
